steps.action_input:
{"code": "from collections import Counter
letters = 'hayjmhrrlodazeixvuawwuajxphehwrregtvvagbacwoylthtnty mpycqqvmlijnoolylunxxrdxegjfitokyi fzr xj p a q k x f d r x f x f f g m s f e d z f i r x p q k x y f f u o v k i p a g i l p i j s u d i x i i b u e a d j g f c j w x n t n s d p a l s g c l m y w s m w d x o z c y m j d q w p y d t d x o f m i n s p f f m i f p z u j z x s r v t f j z c t z n a t t c n n a u w m h e h i x t w z l r i j g n f h k g h w e r b j i v z x i s o v c h j z b p s h j p q q r s a c a k j e r x v f x n n y t x j k s w d c x f l j w z n u e s y v n j s q g g l p a i l l e t j l h o o w j a o u e f a i t h s t g q p q h'
letters = letters.replace(' ', '').replace('\n', '')
counts = Counter(letters)
odd_chars = [char for char, count in counts.items() if count % 2 != 0]
print(f'Total letters: {len(letters)}')
print(f'Odd frequency characters: {odd_chars}')
# If a palindrome is possible, construct it
if len(odd_chars) <= 1:
    half_palindrome = []
    middle = odd_chars[0] if odd_chars else ''
    for char, count in sorted(counts.items()):
        half_palindrome.append(char * (count // 2))
    first_half = ''.join(half_palindrome)
    palindrome = first_half + middle + first_half[::-1]
    print(f'Palindrome: {palindrome}')
    print(f'Palindrome length matches input: {len(palindrome) == len(letters)}')
    print(f'Is palindrome: {palindrome == palindrome[::-1]}')
else:
    print('A palindrome cannot be formed with these letters.')"}
